demo.title: basket.sh
demo.code:
curl -s -G "https://maxxagent.xyz/api/skill/basket" \
  --data-urlencode "prompt=AI and cloud, anything but Tesla, cap each at 30%, keep 10% in cash" \
  --data-urlencode "amount=200"

setup: Install the skill. No API key, account or funds are needed.
Ask for a basket in plain English, e.g. "AI and cloud stocks, no Tesla, max 30% each".
Open the returned link to review the basket and buy it from your own wallet (eligible non-US persons only).
